title: Add reusable Chinese PDF export for saved report configurations
description: Customer downloads current authorized configuration preview through one shared PDF endpoint reusing fresh execution and evidence contract from prior Excel task. Use installed PDFsharp and existing public SimHeiPdfFontResolver without font installation or changing old exporters. One dataset-agnostic renderer supports selected columns, repeated headers, wrapping and horizontal column bands with stable row identity; prevent clipping signed numbers and context. Repeat meaningful row identifiers per band without disclosing unauthorized hidden fields. If no permitted row identifier, use local current-page row ordinal. Always label current-page scope and currency-separated subtotals; never imply all-match totals. Font absence/render failure returns controlled error and no partial file. Metadata preserves normalized filters/date range, definition/version, units, grain and unknown states. UI error handling retains controls and rejects stale download responses. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Generic PDF endpoint uses fresh authenticated execution and the same selected rows/evidence as Excel for draft or pinned revision.
Chinese PDF paginates and bands wide tables with repeated permitted identity/header and visible complete numeric/evidence context; font failures return no partial download.
Workspace PDF download and offline PDF/API/UI tests cover empty/wide/negative/null data, revoked scope and render failure and safe build/test passes.
